sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:13833
Court No. - 12

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 14700 of 2023
Applicant :- Vikas Kumar Dubey @ Chandan Dubey
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Sukh Deo Singh,Paritosh Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Surendra Singh
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today by the counsel for the complainant is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Surendra Singh, learned counsel for the complainant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
3.

In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that on 30.11.2019 the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant and sufficient dowry was also given, subsequently there were demand of dowry,
however, on 30.05.2023, the daughter of the informant was killed.
Vikas Kumar Dubey @ Chandan Dubey vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

4. In the light of the said, the submission of the counsel for the applicant is that as per the post mortem report the cause of death is ante mortem hanging and apart from ligature mark no other injury was visible over the body of the deceased.
It is further argued that the applicant is the husband of the deceased and is in custody since 17.08.2023 having no criminal history.

It is further argued that the mother and father of the applicant have been enlarged on bail vide separate orders,
as such, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
5.

The counsel for the informant draws my attention to the telephone call conversation in between the applicant and the deceased, which demonstrates that the relationship in between them were not cordial and were inimical, although the said telephone call conversation is not a part of case diary,
excepting the same for the sake of argument, it does not demonstrate that the victim was subjected to mental or physical harassment by the applicant in relation to the demand of dowry soon before her death.
6. Learned A.G.A. also opposed the bail prayer.

7. Considering the fact that the prima facie ingredients specified under Section 304-B IPC are primarily missing, even in the telephone call conversation, a case for bail is made out, particularly when the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 17.08.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Vikas Kumar Dubey @ Chandan Dubey be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 289 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Dehat, District Sultanpur on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/-
each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.2.2024 Arun  Vikas Kumar Dubey @ Chandan Dubey vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
